title: About us — Alimat Group, 15 years in the labour market
desc: Alimat Group: 15 years of connecting companies with workers from around the world. History, values, group brands and the Source-to-Operations model.
lead: For 15 years we have been connecting companies with workers from all over the world, helping to build stable teams that genuinely support business growth.
intro_t: A leader in process outsourcing for the meat industry and in temporary staffing
intro_p: We support our Partners in effective people management and HR consulting, in both Polish and international companies. We recruit temporary workers for production, logistics and HoReCa, as well as specialists and managers.

We believe effective recruitment does not end at the moment of hiring. Its real value is **well-functioning teams** within our Partners' organisations. That is why we keep our own candidate database, which we keep growing, and look after workers throughout their employment.
quote: The value of the path we have chosen is created by the people we walk it with every day.
story_t: From a local agency to a group of five brands
story: We started locally, with recruitment and process optimisation in the demanding meat industry. We quickly earned recognition for professionalism, reliability and an individual approach to every assignment.
Year after year we widened our services and entered new markets and industries. Today we work in the Source-to-Operations model, from sourcing workers to managing teams at the Partner's site.
We look ahead with ambitious plans: further expansion and a stronger position as a labour-market leader, with even more value for workers and clients.
values_t: What every partnership is built on
values: Clear terms, legal employment and keeping our word, towards workers and clients alike.
We stay in touch at every stage, from recruitment to day-to-day work on site.
15 years of experience, proven processes and coordinators who speak the workers' languages.
We build long-term relationships based on trust and a shared drive for success.
group_note: Alimat Partners includes the companies Matmeat, Meatwork and AMM Service.
career_t: We are not just an employer, but a partner
career_p: A company's success depends on the people who make it. We look for people open to working in a diverse environment who want to grow with us and influence how the organisation develops. We offer mutual respect, support and real opportunities to grow.
cand_d: Legal work in Poland with accommodation and a coordinator's support.
firm_d: Temporary staffing, process outsourcing and permanent recruitment: the Source-to-Operations model.
